messages:
sam-marketing: Quick thread: need a short, distinct one-pager + 1-page field playbook for enterprise accounts focusing on security, SLAs, and deployment options. This is for the upcoming benchmark webinar and should be different from other one-pagers already in marketing. Aim for a sharp decision sentence + 3 illustrative bullets. Draft by Tue EOD.
evam-product: I'll sketch the decision sentence. Kei, can you add perf/provision bullets?
kei-se: sure. Hosted: instant onboarding, good for experimentation, standard API uptime. Dedicated: best for sustained high throughput; typical SLOs for committed capacity ~99.95%. Private: completes regulatory requirements; integrates with KMS and audit logs. Add note: cache/prefetch reduces per-token costs and improves p95.
rachel-sales: I'll make the field playbook routing logic: inbound form should include compliance checkbox, expected sustained rps, data residency. Routing rules: compliance -> AE + legal; sustained rps > 1000 -> Dedicated; air-gapped -> Private + infra-eng. Add play: if unsure, tag #eng-se for triage.
maya-legal: Approved privacy line: "We process customer data per contract; we only use customer data to improve models with explicit written consent." Also: don't use exact SLA numbers in external collateral; use "example SLOs" phrasing.
sam-marketing: Draft copy idea for the one-pager header: "High-performance inference that fits your security posture" with a 1-line decision matrix: "Experiment: Hosted. Scale predictably: Dedicated. Regulated workloads: Private." Keep benchmark wording vague: "sample throughput: thousands of tokens/sec on Dedicated configs."
kei-se: Demo checklist for field playbook: "run quick smoke test with customer's sample workload, verify KV cache warms and p95 latency meets the stated requirement, confirm KMS encryption path for private deployments" with a pseudo-command: `redwood_smoke --model m --seq 512 --clients 4 --duration 300`.
evam-product: Also add a fallback sentence: "Automatic model routing maintains availability by falling back to compatible variants or regions."
rachel-sales: I'll also include a short objection-handler: "Concern: guarantees" -> "Response: Dedicated with contractual SLOs and legal support for enterprise agreements."
sam-marketing: Ok I'll assemble and upload to marketing/assets/enterprise after approvals. Everyone please review within 48 hours. Thanks! :rocket:
